newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK POLICE ARREST HEROIN DRUG SMUGGLERS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK POLICE ARREST HEROIN DRUG SMUGGLERS.

text.p: Police in Salonica arrested four Egyptians and seized eight kilos of heroin that had been smuggled into Greece from the neighbouring countries of the FYROM, Bulgaria and Turkey, the Athens News Agency reported.
Arrested were Egyptians Yosev Halid, 36, Shafer Ambdel, 28, Mehmet Absoulen, 37, Ala Alsanav, 31, and Bulgarian student Stoyan Krikorov, 23.
The former were arrested separately, on three different occasions of drug trafficking over the weekend. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
